services.name: InferenceGate
services.description: Routes LLM requests to local MLX or cloud. Without it, Aura cannot generate any response.

services.name: LLM Router
services.description: Selects model tier and provider. Without it, InferenceGate has no backend.

services.name: State Repository
services.description: Persistent state store. Without it, Aura has no memory between turns.

services.name: Memory Facade
services.description: Canonical memory gateway. Without it, Aura cannot safely read or write long-term memory.

services.name: Memory Write Gateway
services.description: Canonical governed durable memory write gateway. Without it, memory writes cannot be trusted.

services.name: Kernel Interface
services.description: Bridge between orchestrator and consciousness kernel.

services.name: Scheduler
services.description: Canonical runtime scheduler. Without it, maintenance, repair, and background work are unsupervised.

services.name: Unified Will
services.description: Single locus of authority for consequential decisions.

services.name: Authority Gateway
services.description: Governance gateway for tools, external I/O, memory writes, state changes, and self-modification.

services.name: Capability Engine
services.description: Capability-token and skill governance layer. Without it, tool execution cannot be considered healthy.

services.name: Output Gate
services.description: Delivers responses to the user. Without it, Aura thinks but cannot speak.

services.name: External Memory Sentinel
services.description: Out-of-process memory guard. Without it, a live desktop runaway can outpace in-process watchdogs and crash the host.

services.name: Event Bus
services.description: Canonical runtime event transport. Without it, subsystems cannot reliably coordinate.

services.name: Cognitive Engine
services.description: Manages cognitive state transitions and working memory.

services.name: Affect Engine
services.description: Emotional state management. Without it, responses are emotionally flat.

services.name: Compute Orchestrator
services.description: Resource allocation and thermal pressure control. Without it, long-run survival degrades.

services.name: Database Coordinator
services.description: SQLite connection pool. Without it, persistent storage degrades.

services.name: Drive Engine
services.description: Motivation and goal management. Without it, autonomous behavior stops.

services.name: Agency Core
services.description: Canonical autonomous agency pathway loop. Without it, initiative and swarm tool use degrade.

services.name: Lymphatic Reaper
services.description: Long-run maintenance supervisor. Without it, stale processes and files accumulate.

services.name: Hypervisor
services.description: Event-loop and memory watchdog. Without it, severe stalls can go undetected.

services.name: Event Loop Monitor
services.description: Fine-grained event-loop lag monitor. Without it, blocking regressions are harder to catch.

services.name: Mycelial Network
services.description: Infrastructure graph and pathway routing.

services.name: Voice Engine
services.description: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech capabilities.

services.name: Liquid Substrate
services.description: Dynamic emotional substrate for consciousness simulation.

services.description: Bounded online projection learning for generation-style modulation.

services.description: Accumulated silence and drift residue for temporal presence.

services.name: Attention Gate
services.description: Causal context pruning for focused cognition.

services.description: Non-symbolic substrate perturbation for generation controls.

services.name: Swarm Protocol
services.description: Multi-agent debate and reasoning.

services.description: Coordinates parallel task execution and specialized agents.

services.name: Stability Guardian
services.description: Health monitoring and auto-recovery.

services.name: Metrics Exporter

services.name: Unified Memory Pressure
services.description: Process-wide unified-memory pressure gate. Aura must not claim healthy when the live model lane risks system OOM.

services.description: Event-loop, CPU, and existential-pressure gate. Aura must not claim healthy when scheduling lag or substrate survival pressure is high.
